requirement.statement: web-server SHALL provide POST /api/execute-kon for Kon scripts: requests contain {source: string, scope?: object}; successful responses contain {status:"ok", data?: QueryResultData, result?: unknown}, with table-shaped values normalized as data and other final values returned as result; failures contain {status:"error", error: string}. Each request SHALL execute independently against the configured demo data sources. The legacy POST /api/execute FlowCell product endpoint SHALL NOT be provided.

case.given: the server has initialized its demo data
case.when: POST /api/execute-kon executes a Kon spl_connect plus spl_query script
case.then: the response SHALL be status=ok with the expected data.columns and data.rows

case.given: source references an unknown data source or has invalid syntax
case.then: the response SHALL be {status:"error", error} with actionable detail

case.when: the web server receives the request
case.then: the server SHALL NOT expose a legacy FlowCell product endpoint
